create_mask_generation_pipeline: create a MaskGenerationPipeline to generate binary segmentation masks from images using SAM models
run_mask_generation_pipeline: run the MaskGenerationPipeline on an image URL to produce binary masks with confidence scores
configure_preprocess_crops: configure MaskGenerationPipeline preprocess with crops_n_layers and crop_overlap_ratio for multi-scale mask generation
filter_masks_with_iou_threshold: filter generated masks using pred_iou_thresh and stability_score_thresh thresholds in the forward pass
postprocess_rle_bounding_boxes: postprocess MaskGenerationPipeline outputs with output_rle_mask and output_bboxes_mask flags for RLE and bounding box formats
